priority_basis: The product is published on note but has zero recorded sales and no verified external traffic. A second zero-upfront-cost digital marketplace can diversify discovery and payment access without paid advertising.

channel.calculation_note: 5.6% variable fee rounded up to the next yen, plus 45 yen. Transfer, tax, refund and other individual conditions are excluded.

automation_review.direct_execution: Research, fee calculation, listing title, description, tags, product-size validation and mobile launcher are completed in the authorized repository.
automation_review.official_api: No authenticated BOOTH shop-management action is connected. Credentials are not requested or stored.
automation_review.browser_prefill: A mobile HTML launcher copies all listing fields and opens BOOTH management.
automation_review.batching: Title, price, description, tags, product path, fee estimate and official references are consolidated into one page.
automation_review.verification: CI passed checks for listing length, required disclaimers, no external note promotion, ZIP type, ZIP member count, file-size compatibility, fee calculation, repository state and the automation-before-user gate.

residual_user_action.reason: BOOTH login, shop or payout setup, file selection, contract acceptance and final publication require the authenticated account holder.
steps: Open BOOTH management and create a downloadable item, creating the shop or payout destination only if not already configured.
Use the launcher to paste the prepared title, price, description and tags, then select the generated ZIP.
Review the listing and confirm final publication.

success_condition: The ZIP product is publicly purchasable and downloadable on BOOTH without using the listing mainly to redirect outside BOOTH.
next_assistant_actions: After a BOOTH public URL exists, add it to channel-specific distribution and metrics tracking.
Verify the public listing and downloadable-product configuration after publication.
Do not assume BOOTH organic discovery; compare channel traffic and net sales after measurable data exists.
